Quirk Forensics.text: Quirk forensics is the police work of identifying a suspect by the traces a Quirk leaves. Scorch patterns from a particular kind of fire, acid etching, frost lines, crushed metal with a telltale shape, residues of produced substances, and entry routes that point to phasing or warping all count. Forensic teams record the traces, compare past cases and search the national Quirk registry for powers that could produce them, which is why villains with distinctive Quirks are identified quickly and many try to hide their power during a crime. Witness accounts of what a Quirk did often matter more than a face. Quirk traces rarely convict anyone alone; they point the investigation, and ordinary evidence finishes it.
